integrity: All-graph proof via explicit cochain coefficient reduction; finite exact direct cochain-matrix checks are supplementary, with no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only connected finite simple graphs with at least two vertices; normalized degree-two quandle cohomology with trivial binary coefficients. General disconnected-graph and integral torsion cases are not treated; broader implicit literature coverage remains possible.
title: Binary second quandle cohomology detects complete multipartite graph quandles
